title: Summarise the talk on progress

scenario.en: You heard a short talk about learning from failure. A classmate asks what it was about.
scenario.ar: سمعت محاضرة قصيرة عن التعلّم من الفشل. زميلك بيسألك كانت عن إيه.

source: The speaker said: 'I spent six months avoiding English, because I wanted to speak perfectly, so I said nothing. Then a colleague and I agreed to speak for ten minutes every morning, with one rule: mistakes were allowed, silence was not. After three months I had stopped translating in my head.'

task.en: Summarise the talk, then give your opinion about the speaker's rule.
task.ar: لخّص المحاضرة، وبعدين قول رأيك في قاعدة المتحدث.

key_points.en: He avoided English for six months because he wanted to be perfect.
key_points.ar: اتجنّب الإنجليزي ٦ شهور لأنه عايز يكون مثالي.

key_points.en: He agreed to speak ten minutes every morning with a colleague.
key_points.ar: اتفق يتكلم ١٠ دقايق كل صباح مع زميل.

key_points.en: Their rule was that mistakes were allowed but silence was not.
Give your opinion about the rule.

model_answer.en: In short, he avoided English for six months because he wanted to speak perfectly. Then he agreed with a colleague to speak ten minutes every morning, and their rule was that mistakes were allowed but silence was not. After three months he had stopped translating in his head. Personally, I think that rule is the useful part.
model_answer.ar: باختصار، اتجنّب الإنجليزي ٦ شهور لأنه كان عايز يتكلم مثالي. وبعدين اتفق مع زميل يتكلموا ١٠ دقايق كل صباح، وقاعدتهم إن الغلط مسموح والسكوت لأ. وبعد ٣ شهور بقى مش بيترجم في دماغه. شخصيًا أنا شايف إن القاعدة دي هي الجزء المفيد.
